gaps.explanation: p9 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints enterprise columns Electric, Water, Sewer, Trash with no schedule of their own; detail[] has no business-type lines. JSON receipts = total operating revenues 801,169 + interest income 2,848 + franchise fees 39,232 + gain on disposal of assets 10,500 = 853,749. Per column: Electric 308,110 + 6,787 + 2,645 + 8,250 = 325,792; Water 269,224 + 706 + 203 + 19,616 + 2,250 = 291,999; Sewer 133,800 + 808 + 19,616 = 154,224; Trash 81,734. Sum 853,749 = statement.
